description: Simultaneous multi-axis withheld-plane validation of the frozen logarithmic interpolator, fixed 2026-09-10 before any error was computed. Motivation: OC-004 queries the interpolator off-grid in temperature, field and angle at once (21 K, pack field, mapped angle), while every OC-003 fold withheld one axis at a time. This fold withholds planes along all three axes simultaneously and reports errors by the number of off-grid axes; the three-axis stratum is the direct analogue of an OC-004 query. Pre-declared consequence: if the three-axis stratum's worst positive relative error exceeds 0.10, OC-004's declared interpolation_overprediction_budget (0.10) is insufficient, a new coupled case must declare a budget of at least the observed value, and OC-004's screening results are re-labelled as depending on an unvalidated budget. The interpolator is not tuned on this fold under any outcome. Same specimen as OC-003; development validation, not an independent-batch or reserved test.
holdout_policy: Remove every measurement whose nominal temperature, field or angle lies on a withheld plane; train on the remaining 3 x 4 x 22 nominal grid (264 measurements) with the dataset's declared cell spans. Score every removed point that lies strictly inside the nominal bounds along each axis that is not withheld for that point; record boundary omissions; preserve every eligible point in the coverage denominator. Classify each scored point by the number of its nominal coordinates lying on withheld planes (one, two or three) and report count, coverage, P95, worst and worst positive relative error per stratum as well as for the whole fold. Supporting rows of every prediction must be training rows.
